odin_ranges.metric_definition: Change in the value of wheat imports from Orvan via the sea corridor comparing Q4 2026 (post-expiration) to Q4 2025.
assumptions: Prior year import levels represent baseline demand.
odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: The ranges are derived from year-over-year comparisons of official trade notes for the period immediately following the agreement's expiration.

odin_ranges.metric_definition: Change in the value of maize imports from Orvan via the sea corridor following the agreement's expiration.
odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: High-confidence trade notes show a clear value decline despite a one-month buffer in October due to delayed delivery terms.

odin_ranges.metric_definition: Change in the value of wheat imports from Orvan via the sea corridor comparing Q4 2026 to Q4 2025.

odin_ranges.uncertainty_note: The range reflects the substantial loss in sea-trade value, which alternative Vanir shipments failed to fully offset.
